description:
Writes a partial backup file with the chosen items and the linked items you pick as a pending download (GET /backups/pending/{id}), once; nothing is stored. Without secrets the file is not encrypted. With secrets (manage on every included kind, and a passphrase of at least 12 characters) private keys, access list passwords and DNS credential values are included, encrypted; ACME account keys only go into an administrator's export. The file can only be merged, on a list page import. Errors carry a backup.error.<code> message id: invalid-types (also when no item is chosen), weak-passphrase, busy.

Needs: view on the section of the chosen kind (Proxy Hosts, Redirection Hosts, 404 Hosts, Streams, Access Lists or Certificates; DNS credentials use Certificates); secrets also need manage on every included kind

ids.description: The ids of the items to export.

certificates.description: Ids of the linked certificates to include; those from the preview you leave out are not exported.

access_lists.description: Ids of the linked access lists to include.

dns_credentials.description: Ids of the linked DNS credentials to include.

secrets.description: Include secrets, encrypted with the passphrase

passphrase.description: Passphrase, at least 12 characters, never stored

200.description: The pending download id and file name

pending.description: The id to download the file with, once, from GET /backups/pending/{id}.

name.description: The file name to offer for the download.
